title: Kinetic comic halftone UI
blurb: Turn plain semantic <nav> and <form> HTML into rotated CMYK Ben-Day halftone print on the GPU with cursor-lit dot gain, chromatic ink offset, diagonal blade-wipe transitions and hit-stop shake.
question: Can plain semantic <nav> and <form> HTML be turned on the GPU into rotated CMYK Ben-Day halftone print with cursor-lit dot radius, chromatic ink-outline offset, diagonal blade-wipe panel transitions and subtle hit-stop shake while remaining keyboard-accessible and responsive to prefers-reduced-motion: reduce?
result: Not verified in a live browser yet. One ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas uploads the active panel via texElementSubImage2D(), separates it into four angled CMYK Ben-Day screens over paper tooth, captures outgoing panels into a GPU framebuffer for diagonal jagged blade-wipe cuts with 35 ms hit-stop shake (suppressed to 0 px under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce), and aligns slanted hit testing with updateElementGeometry() scaled by geometryUnit().
